description: Dose-response curve data: OCC gradient flow duration → Collision Avoidance Rate (CAR)
eval_protocol: 50r SafeLIBERO Level I (10 tasks × 50 rollouts = 500 episodes)

conditions.description: OCC head attached but gradient detached (occ_detach=True, BN)
OCC gradient flow only for first 15K steps (30% of training)
conditions.note: Surprisingly high CAR — higher than Full OCC avg. Non-monotonic?

conditions.description: OCC gradient flow only for first 25K steps (50% of training)
conditions.note: High variance across seeds (0.688-0.760). Severe withdrawal effect?

conditions.description: OCC gradient flow only for first 35K steps (70% of training)
OCC gradient flow only for first 45K steps (90% of training)
Full OCC with gradient flow throughout (occ_detach=False, BN)
No OCC gradient first 35K steps, enable OCC 35K-50K. Same duration as cutoff_15k but late-phase.
conditions.note: Same 15K gradient flow duration as cutoff_15k but CAR much lower (0.718 vs 0.804). Timing matters: early > late.

key_findings.non_monotonic_pattern: cutoff_15k (0.804) > Full OCC (0.797) > cutoff_35k (0.779) > cutoff_45k (0.764) > Detach (0.746). Longer is NOT always better.
key_findings.withdrawal_effect: cutoff_25k shows severe instability (std=0.051) and low mean (0.724). Mid-training cutoff may be worst timing.
key_findings.early_vs_late: cutoff_15k (early 15K, CAR=0.804) >> reverse_cutoff (late 15K, CAR=0.718). Early gradient flow more impactful.
key_findings.caveat: cutoff_15k/cutoff_45k have only 1 seed complete. Multi-seed may shift conclusions.
